summary: Tubular (DX7-style FM): field units, envelope rate timings measured on the engine, how voices load
body: Fields take DX7 panel values, stored 0-based where the panel isn't: algorithm 0..31 is panel 1..32; detune 0..14 is -7..+7; transpose 0..48 with 24 = no transpose; levels and rates 0..99; feedback 0..7.

operators/0..5 are OP1..OP6 in panel order (a voice's bytes store OP6 first; TubularPreset handles that). Which operators are carriers depends on the algorithm: in algorithm 5 (panel), OP1, OP3 and OP5 are carriers, each modulated by the next.

Envelope rates measured by openDAW's authors (time to -60 dB from full): R30 8.5 s, R35 5 s, R40 3 s, R45 1.9 s, R50 0.9 s, R55 0.55 s, R60 0.3 s, R65 0.2 s, R70 0.12 s. Attack to full: R30 1.5 s, R40 0.5 s, R50 0.17 s, R60 50 ms.
To make a voice duller, lower the modulators' outputLevel (not cutoff); brighter, raise them or the feedback. Loading a voice sets every field and the instrument's label.
